hazards.control: Test the stack to the program pressures; bleed and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Choke manifold and kill line (workover)
function: The manifold that takes a kick through an adjustable choke while the kill line pumps kill fluid: the same hardware family as the flowback choke manifold, plumbed to the stack outlets.

tabs.overview: Choke line from the spool to the manifold; kill line from the pumps to the spool; gauges and a mud gas separator downstream on drilling rigs.
tabs.engineering: Rated with the stack; per API Std 53 arrangement.
tabs.safety: Lined up and tested before the stack is put to work.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 16A (S48), API Std 53 (S49), API RP 16ST (S53), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
